lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Stripe 8 and 9 (counting from anterior) show distinct discontinuities, terminating mid-torso before reaching the ventral fringe.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of 5 high-contrast white spots is visible on the lower haunch area, situated above the rear hock.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Lyrate trajectory; horns emerge at approx 40-degree lateral angles before curving inward toward the midline and upward.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: Terminal horn tip distance is approximately 2.2 times the pixel width of the combined horn bases.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: Light-colored ivory tips constitute approximately the terminal 15% of the total horn vertical height.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white chevron between the eyes and two distinct white spots on the lower mandible/cheek area; dorsal mane consists of elongated white/grey pixel clusters.
